notes.68.1: Genzan, Jordan, Vrô, Lazakere and Tumbe are kept as names. Vrô may be 'lord'. 'tump/tumbe' also means 'dumb, mute, foolish', perhaps playing on stilling the blood. 'molt petritto' is not German and is kept as it stands.

nodes.text: Genzan and Jordan went shooting together;
then Genzan shot Jordan in the side.
Then the blood stopped. May this blood stop.
Vrô and Lazakere went molt petritto.
Tumbe sat on the mountain with the Tumbe child in his arm.
Tump the mountain was called, Tump the child was called.
May holy Tumbe bless away this wound.
